title: Allowing Traffic to the ID Federation URL by Bypassing Zscaler Client Connector

blocks.text: To allow users to bypass Zscaler Client Connector when they browse to your organization’s identity federation URL for authentication, add a custom PAC file to their app profile:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > <OS>.
On the App Profiles tab, select one of the following:
Select an existing policy and click Edit (✎).
Click Add <OS> Policy to create a new policy.
On the PAC and Proxy tab, under PAC Configuration, for Custom PAC URL, enter the URL for the custom PAC file.

To learn more about creating a custom PAC file, see Writing a PAC File. To learn how to use a PAC file with Zscaler Client Connector, see Best Practices for Using PAC Files with Zscaler Client Connector.
